title: wolfssl_ecdsa_sign: accepts 20-byte digest (SHA-1) — FIPS 140-3 violation
description: wolfssl_ecdsa_sign checks digest_len < 20 and rejects. The comment reads 'SHA-1 minimum, though SHA-256+ is strongly preferred for new signatures'. FIPS 140-3 and NIST SP 800-186 do not approve ECDSA with SHA-1 for new signatures. Accepting a 20-byte digest allows callers to sign SHA-1 hashes through a FIPS-gated path. Minimum approved digest size for ECDSA is 32 bytes (SHA-256). Fix: change the check to digest_len < 32, update comment to cite SP 800-186 Table 2.
